text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
On a day off, while wandering around the 
shopping street, I ran into Seiun Sky 
carrying a large amount of shopping.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Yeah, I'm out shopping~. Gathering tons 
of materials for a cat house.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yup. A home for the neighborhood kitties. 
The shopping street folks asked if I could 
make one~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So right now, I'm agonizing over wall 
materials~. Trainer-san, what kind of 
walls do you think would be good?
choice_data_list:
Um... maybe thick walls so it doesn't 
break?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Mmh. Great minds think alike. Durability 
is a non-negotiable point for Sei-chan 
too.
choice_data_list: ええと……壊れないように、厚めの壁とか？
choice_data_list_en: Uhm... maybe thicker walls so it doesn't break?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Plus, thicker walls block out sound 
better. ...Kitties are super sensitive to 
noises, after all.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Exactly, exactly~. Those cute little ears 
move independently, and their hearing is a 
whole four times better than a human's!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
So, prioritizing soundproofing and 
sturdiness for the walls. I guess that 
model over there is the one~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Whoa, wait a second? Sei-chan just 
realized a little problem.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
If I buy such huge wall panels, I won't be 
able to carry anything else... Oh dear, 
what to do~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Aha~. Sorry for making you carry my 
stuff~!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you, it looks like we can buy a 
roof for the cat house too~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Now then—when picking a roof, 
waterproofing is definitely the main 
concern, right meow~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Kitties hate water, so we have to make 
sure they don't catch a cold from the 
rain—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Or so they say! Actually, there are 
kitties who don't mind water at all. Did 
ya know~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Their breed is the Turkish Van. They'll 
actually go swimming right in the water, 
believe it or not.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Dishes at the right height for kitties to 
eat easily, and chew toys for tooth 
cleaning are all bought~. All that's left 
is...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
This right here. I've been eyeing it for a 
while~. The "Cushion That Turns Any Animal 
Into a Sloth"!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oh feline overlords... please grace this 
cushion with your wondrous, sacred 
"belly-up flop"~.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yep, yep~. That cute way they sleep, all 
melted on their backs♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Well... doggies and wild lions also sleep 
belly-up, but the feelings behind it vary.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Among them all, a cat's belly-up flop is 
supposedly proof of supreme, ultimate 
relaxation!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—And with that, the ultimate pieces have 
gathered. Thanks for carrying everything, 
Trainer~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Cat expert Seiun Sky meticulously selected 
every part for the cat house. I'm really 
curious to see how the cats will react...
choice_data_list:
Shall we try building the cat house right 
away?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Oho. You're motivated~. Well then, let's 
get to it!
choice_data_list: ネコハウス、早速作ってみる？
choice_data_list_en: Want to try building that cat house right away?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Ah, here they come. Trainer, look over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Local Cats
text_block_list.text: ...Meow~. Meow~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cats slowly wandered closer. They 
seemed startled by the unfamiliar newly 
built house at first, but soon...
choice_data_list_en: ...At last, the time for the big reveal!

text_block_list.name: Local Cats
text_block_list.text: Nya... Nya-nya-nya!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hehe... There, there!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cats rolled around on the cozy mats 
and played enthusiastically with the toys, 
fully enjoying themselves. And then—

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Hehe, fast asleep on the cushion~. Did 
everyone like it, I wonder~?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—Ah. Take a look at that one. Now that's a 
truly glorious belly-up flop~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The cats slept soundly inside the cat 
house. Thanks to the environment Seiun Sky 
set up, they ended up soothed entirely 
according to her plan...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking back on the way to the magazine 
photoshoot the other day— It feels like 
she was cleverly using and arranging her 
surroundings just to relax to the absolute 
maximum.
choice_data_list: (So that's how she could rest anywhere!)

(So that's why she was able to relax 
anywhere!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Man~. That was a total breeze, though~.
choice_data_list: （だから、どんな場所でも休めてたのか！）
（だから、どんな場所でも休めてたんだ！）
choice_data_list_en: (So that's how she was able to rest anywhere!)
(So that's how she was able to rest anywhere!)

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my excellent assistant, the cat 
house got finished in half the time, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before I knew it, she had stoked my 
curiosity and had me helping her out until 
the very end!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fufun♪ It wouldn't be any fun if I laid 
all my cards on the table... just kidding, 
you know?
choice_data_list: 恐れ入りました、スカイさん……

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a true trickster horse 
girl. Just how far ahead she thinks is 
almost terrifying!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Nyahaha, sooorry♪ How about some honey 
drink as thanks?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
As expected of a true trickster horse 
girl. I was completely guided along 
without even realizing it!
